hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; h="$d/HANDOFF.md"; if [ ! -f "$h" ]; then g=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && h="$g/HANDOFF.md"; fi; if [ -f "$h" ] && head -1 "$h" | grep -q '^# HANDOFF'; then echo '=== HANDOFF.md — pick up from here (auto-injected) ==='; head -120 "$h"; [ "$(wc -l < "$h")" -gt 120 ] && echo '… (truncated at 120 lines — the file is over its 80-line budget; trim it)'; echo; echo '=== Reality check (computed at session start — if HANDOFF disagrees with this, trust this) ==='; b=$(git -C "$d" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$b" ] && echo "· branch: $b"; echo '· git status:'; git -C "$d" status --short 2>/dev/null | head -15; n=$(git -C "$d" status --short 2>/dev/null | wc -l); [ "$n" -gt 15 ] && echo "  … $((n-15)) more changed files"; echo '· last commits:'; git -C "$d" log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; echo '=== Keep HANDOFF.md current: overwrite it (never append) before the session ends — /handoff:handoff ==='; fi
